mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sprints (project_id, name, goal, status, start_date, end_date, sort_order) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{name}, #{goal}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'FUTURE'), #{startDate}, #{endDate}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sprints WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sprints SET status = 'ACTIVE', start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, started_at = #{startedAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sprints SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(sort_order) FROM sprints WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
